answer: Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. The zephyr register is checked at draw time, lotus lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 263 pays that 72 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
